interlūcō

interlūcō, interlūcāre

verb, first conjugation

thin a tree by cutting out branches, so as to let the light through

In this lexicon

  • thin out

    the recommended word · post-classical · Plin. NH 17.94: adultās interlūcāre jūstō plūs; Plin. NH 17.214: interlūcātā dēnsitāte rāmōrum (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • adultās interlūcāre jūstō plūs

    to thin grown trees out more than is rightPlin. NH 17.94
